verdict.rationale: Poly has a native tag system: Finder tags sync bidirectionally with Poly tags, colors included. That shows tags can be attached to files, including Markdown notes in the Mind folder. Nothing in the pack documents typed properties or metadata fields, or using tags as search or filter criteria. Missing for 10: typed properties or metadata fields on notes, documented tag-based filtering and retrieval, consistent tag management across notes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
